quest.title: The Joyous Floating Island
quest.description: One day, a mysterious voice invites you to visit her witch's lodge...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Push the door open and enter.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Welcome.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, your home's so pretty! Paimon loves what you've done with it!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Hehe, I knew you'd appreciate it, Paimon. Hearing that makes it all feel worthwhile, even if I had to squeeze it in during my spare time.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: It all started the day I finished building this secret lodge...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: I was planning to keep the streak going and build a few more, but there was no one around to inspire me. So after a while, my enthusiasm just sort of... fizzled out.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: "Is there no way to have fun, enjoy myself, and feel like I've accomplished something all at the same time?" Then the answer suddenly popped into my head!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, have we skipped straight to the answer?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Keep up, Paimon — time waits for no one. Look, it's right in front of your eyes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Through this door?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Well, not just this door, but you're not wrong. Everything has to start somewhere — what better place than here? Are you ready?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait a minute, you're going too fast! Paimon can't keep up... What are we supposed to be getting ready for?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Oh, don't you worry about that. You don't need to get ready for anything — it's just a turn of phrase.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Based on my observations and understanding... you're not a fan of complex introductions and explanations. You prefer to find your fun in the heat of adventure, am I right?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Haha, glad to hear it! In that case, brace yourselves — I don't plan to hold back!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: You know us angels. We just can't resist the satisfaction of guiding adventurers to treasure.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Well, seeing as the goal's to be kind and help others find happiness, why shouldn't I start by giving my own friends a few happy pointers?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: So, I had a sudden stroke of genius! I transformed my little lodge into a place where you can relax and have fun. I even hid treasure in each and every room!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: To tell you the truth, even compared to the other angels, I'm quite the expert when it comes to hiding things!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: If I were to bury a chest in the wild and not show you the way, I'm afraid you wouldn't be able to find it even after months of searching.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Ahem... Anyway... I digress.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: I don't want to make things deliberately difficult, nor do I need you to run around the wild just to keep me entertained...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: All you have to do is find three feathers, right here in this room! And once you're done, let me know so I can watch you open your reward — a nice, big treasure chest!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahhh, so we're going on a treasure hunt! Paimon can't wait!

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Exactly! A treasure hunt. It's going to be so fun!

choices.text: But I'd still quite like an introduction this time.
It's an honor to be here.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A gust of wind suddenly brushes across your face.\nHow strange... It carries the aroma of Fruit Tandem Turnovers, Midsommar Torte, Crispy Roast, and Berry Herbal Candy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! A gust of super sweet wind just blew right down Paimon's throat! *cough*... Hey! Where are we? That teapot and those cups look really, really big...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second... Did we shrink!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This feels like Nicole's magic at work.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Apologies, I was hoping to invite animal actors, but alas... I'm used to dealing with thespians of a more... "stony-faced" persuasion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Nicole, you've shrunk, too? Paimon thought you were gonna be huge!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Nicole, the Magnificent Massive Mage, propping up the heavens while crouching down to talk? No, thank you! I'm quite happy with my current size.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Aaaanyway... Welcome to the Great Mage's Tea Party! Now, pour yourselves some tea!

talks.objective: Use Pyro to heat the teapot

dialogues.speaker: Examine Door
dialogues.text: (The faint sound of a teaspoon clinking against porcelain can be heard from behind the door...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Why did it just suddenly slide down like that? And is that a... giant Mandragora statue?

dialogues.speaker: Mandragora
dialogues.text: Clunk...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Hold on a moment. Sorry, just a minor technical difficulty. Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Mandragora
dialogues.text: Click... Clack...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's moving! Hey! Is this thing attacking us!?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Aha, much better...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't help but wonder why you're so excited about these rewards, Nicole...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Sure, Paimon looks forward to {NICKNAME}'s reaction when she gets {M#him}{F#her} a gift, but this feels kinda different...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did I tell you about gift horses, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry about that. I don't mind! At worst, my answer might shatter a few illusions you have about the angelic race. If you thought we were all selfless, benevolent beings, the truth may make you think again.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: As for your question, my dearest Paimon, my excitement has nothing to do with sharing the joy of those I guide. Instead, it derives from completing the duties I am burdened with.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: It all started with the birth of the angels...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: We were entrusted with the mission to love all living beings on this land, but unlike the gods who came after...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: ...Our ability to perceive emotion was crude and undeveloped. Most of the time, we simply executed our orders from above, like automatons following commands.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Aside from "enlightenment," "guidance" was our primary mission. It was one of the few instincts retained by my former peers after they were stripped of their wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Upon completing our missions, we gained a certain sense of joyous relief. It was the most intense emotional experience an angel could normally undergo.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't that... kinda sad?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Maybe, but I prefer not to think of it as something worthy of pity. After all, not even the great ruler of the firmament can deny the truth of the emotions in my heart right now.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Besides, guiding others is a good thing in itself, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Was that a little much? Don't worry, it's incredibly simple — just put your thinking caps on, search high and low, and claim your prize at the end. It's exactly the sort of escapade you two excel at!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe not now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean, much better!?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: #Mm? Come on, it's barely attacking you. You can handle a little spirited tickling, can't you? Besides, this is the perfect opportunity for {NICKNAME} to show off some skills.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Nicole! Help us out here, will ya!?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Alright, alright... "Heaven's will, made mine"!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you come back a little while later? I still need to check that the other rooms are all in working order...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: A gust of wind suddenly brushes across your face.\nHow strange... It carries the aroma of Fruit Tandem Turnovers, Midsommar Torte, Crispy Roast, and Berry Herbal Candy.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#16912
dialogues.text: It doesn't seem sweet enough...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: It doesn't seem sweet enough...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Hah! That's the spot.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#16912
dialogues.text: Hah! That's the spot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, it's that ball of light again! Let's follow it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it disappeared behind that door! Does that mean we can open it now?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: ...And look, the tea's still nice and warm. Mmm, just right, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you just plan this whole thing just so you could sit back and enjoy this moment yourself...?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Hehe, come now... This is your reward. You were the ones who earned it, after all. Go on, then — open it up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Nicole! Help us out here, will ya!?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Alright, alright... "Heaven's will, made mine"!
